title: Pocket Fuel Ultra Berry Ice Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Ultra Berry Ice from Pocket Fuel combines seven deliciously distinct berries with a bracing layer of icy-cool menthol for a vape that’s unbelievably sweet and juicy and endlessly refreshing. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 80VG/20PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
